title: Jeera Aloo
description: Boiled potato cubes pan-fried with cumin seeds until lightly crisp at the edges — a quick dry side that goes with almost any dal or curry.

ingredients.name: Potato
ingredients.notes: boiled, peeled, and cut into cubes

steps: Heat oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Add the cumin seeds and let them sizzle and turn a shade darker, about 30 seconds.
Add the boiled potato cubes and toss gently to coat in the oil, taking care not to break them up.
Sprinkle in the turmeric, red chilli powder and salt, and toss to coat evenly.
Cook, stirring occasionally, for 10-12 minutes until the potatoes develop a light golden crust on some edges.
Sprinkle over the amchur, toss once more, and garnish with coriander leaves before serving.
